name: flight-hunter
description: Find the cheapest or best-value flights the way a human hacker would: Google Flights via fli, Kiwi, Kayak/JetSMART/Buquebus over plain HTTP (no browser), bot-walled airline sites in Chrome, positioning flights, self-transfers, ferries, group-size splits, point-of-sale tricks, a trip watch that re-prices finalists and diffs runs, with visa/bag/connection risk flags. Search only - never books.
